build.script:
set -euxo pipefail
${{ 'export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -D_LIBCPP_DISABLE_AVAILABILITY"' if osx else '' }}
cmake -S . -B build -GNinja \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DGGML_METAL=${{ 'OFF' if not (osx and arm64) else 'ON' }} \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON \
    -DWHISPER_SDL2=ON \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF \
    -DGGML_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }} \
    ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-w"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} \
    $CMAKE_ARGS
cmake --build build
cmake --install build

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: whisper.cpp
  version: "1.9.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ggml-org/${{ name }}/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1650f884effba487025143bd8facd2f9fb40a83b3737a732803c67a8d659d9c0

build:
  number: 0
  dynamic_linking:
    missing_dso_allowlist:
      - if: linux
        then:
          - "*/libcuda.so.1"
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: |
        set -euxo pipefail
        ${{ 'export CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -D_LIBCPP_DISABLE_AVAILABILITY"' if osx else '' }}
        cmake -S . -B build -GNinja \
            -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
            -DGGML_METAL=${{ 'OFF' if not (osx and arm64) else 'ON' }} \
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON \
            -DWHISPER_SDL2=ON \
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF \
            -DGGML_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }} \
            ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-w"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} \
            $CMAKE_ARGS
        cmake --build build
        cmake --install build
      else: |
        cmake -S . -B build -GNinja ^
            -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON ^
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH=$PREFIX/lib/whisper-cpp ^
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON ^
            -DWHISPER_SDL2=ON ^
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ^
            -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF ^
            -DGGML_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }} ^
            ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="61;70;75;80;86;89;90"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} ^
            ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-w -Xcompiler /W0"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} ^
            %CMAKE_ARGS% || exit 1
        cmake --build build -- -j2 || exit 1
        cmake --install build || exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake
    - git
    - ninja
    - pkgconfig
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
      else: llvm-openmp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
  host:
    - sdl2
    - if: not osx
      then:
        - if: blas_impl == 'mkl'
          then:
            - mkl-devel ==${{ mkl }}
          else:
            - blas-devel * *_${{ blas_impl }}
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
      else: llvm-openmp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcublas-dev
  run:
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart
        - libcublas
  run_constraints:
    # llama.cpp also vendors ggml
    - llama.cpp <0.0.0a0

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - whisper-cli
        - whisper-server
        - whisper-bench
      lib:
        - whisper
        - ggml
      include:
        - ggml.h
        - whisper.h

  - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
    then:
      - script:
          - whisper-cli --help

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
  repository: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
  summary: Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pavelzw
    - ruben-arts

about.summary: Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++

build.script:
cmake -S . -B build -GNinja ^
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON ^
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH=$PREFIX/lib/whisper-cpp ^
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES=ON ^
    -DWHISPER_SDL2=ON ^
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ^
    -DWHISPER_BUILD_SERVER=OFF ^
    -DGGML_CUDA=${{ "ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "OFF" }} ^
    ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES="61;70;75;80;86;89;90"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} ^
    ${{ '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS="-w -Xcompiler /W0"' if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else '' }} ^
    %CMAKE_ARGS% || exit 1
cmake --build build -- -j2 || exit 1
cmake --install build || exit 1
